-- Get user interaction history
WITH user_interactions AS (
  SELECT item_id, interaction_type, rating, created_at
  FROM user_interactions
  WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 100
),
user_profile AS (
  SELECT 
    preferences,
    categories_of_interest,
    avg_rating,
    total_interactions
  FROM user_profiles
  WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
)
SELECT 
  json_build_object(
    'interactions', (SELECT json_agg(user_interactions.*) FROM user_interactions),
    'profile', (SELECT row_to_json(user_profile.*) FROM user_profile)
  ) as user_data;

-- Collaborative filtering: Find similar users
WITH user_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT item_id
  FROM user_interactions
  WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
),
similar_users AS (
  SELECT 
    ui.user_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ui.item_id) as common_items,
    AVG(ui.rating) as avg_rating
  FROM user_interactions ui
  WHERE ui.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM user_items)
    AND ui.user_id != '{{ $json.user_id }}'
  GROUP BY ui.user_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ui.item_id) >= 3
  ORDER BY common_items DESC
  LIMIT 50
)
SELECT 
  i.item_id,
  i.item_name,
  i.category,
  i.tags,
  AVG(ui.rating) as predicted_rating,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ui.user_id) as user_count,
  'collaborative_filtering' as algorithm
FROM user_interactions ui
JOIN items i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id
WHERE ui.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM similar_users)
  AND ui.item_id NOT IN (SELECT item_id FROM user_items)
GROUP BY i.item_id, i.item_name, i.category, i.tags
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ui.user_id) >= 3
ORDER BY predicted_rating DESC, user_count DESC
LIMIT {{ $json.limit * 2 }};

-- Content-based: Items similar to user's history
WITH user_preferences AS (
  SELECT 
    i.category,
    UNNEST(i.tags) as tag,
    AVG(ui.rating) as avg_rating
  FROM user_interactions ui
  JOIN items i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id
  WHERE ui.user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
  GROUP BY i.category, tag
  HAVING AVG(ui.rating) >= 3.5
),
user_interacted_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM user_interactions WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
)
SELECT 
  i.item_id,
  i.item_name,
  i.category,
  i.tags,
  i.description,
  COALESCE(up_category.avg_rating, 0) * 0.4 + 
  COALESCE(AVG(up_tags.avg_rating), 0) * 0.6 as content_score,
  'content_based' as algorithm
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN user_preferences up_category ON i.category = up_category.category
LEFT JOIN user_preferences up_tags ON up_tags.tag = ANY(i.tags)
WHERE i.item_id NOT IN (SELECT item_id FROM user_interacted_items)
  AND (up_category.category IS NOT NULL OR up_tags.tag IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY i.item_id, i.item_name, i.category, i.tags, i.description, up_category.avg_rating
ORDER BY content_score DESC
LIMIT {{ $json.limit * 2 }};

INSERT INTO recommendation_logs (
  recommendation_id,
  user_id,
  recommendations,
  algorithm_performance,
  diversity_score,
  processing_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.recommendation_id }}',
  '{{ $json.user_id }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.recommendations) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.algorithm_performance) }}',
  {{ $json.diversity_metrics.unique_categories }},
  {{ $json.metadata.processing_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
